FIRST ADDENDUM 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 V4 Capital (referred to as “Developer” ) and Huma Javaid w/o Muhammad Javaid (referred to as “Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first a ddendum (“ First A ddendum ”) to Agreement to Sell dated [•] 2020 , (“ Agreement to Sell ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•], 202 3 (“ Effective Date ”). 
 WHEREAS 
 The Developer is developing and constructing residential houses located at Phase III, Sector A and Sector B, Defence Housing Authority, Islamabad-Rawalpindi. 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement to Sell bearing No. RA/099 , dated ____________ for the sale and purchase of constructed residential house along with the fixtures and fittings located at Unit No. 9, Street No. 22 , with total area 133 Sq . Yards located at Phase III, Sector A and Sector B, Defence Housing Authority Islamabad-Rawalpindi ( “Property” ) ; 
 The Developer was under obligation to construct a residential house on the land a s part and parcel of the Agreement to Sell and handover the Unit to the Buyer . However, on the request of the Buyer the Developer agreed to transfer Plot No. 9, Street No. 22, with total area 133 Sq. Yards located at Phase III, Sector A, Defence Housing Authority Islamabad-Rawalpindi along with the partially constructed structure on it on ‘where is as is’ basis ( “ Unit ” ) against the Purchase Price (defined below) . 
 P ursuant to Clause 1 4 . 2 of the Agreement , the Parties hereby mutual ly agree to revise , amend and supplement the Agreement in accordance with the terms and conditions hereof. 
 
 NOW , THEREFORE, the P arties agree as follows: 
 The First A ddendum shall be effective from the Effective Date . 
 The Buyer requested and the Developer agreed to revise the terms and conditions of the Agreement to Sell wherein the Developer was under obligation to construct a residential house along with the fixtures and fittings on the Property and sell it to the Buyer against the total sale consideration of PKR 12,000,000 (Rupees twelve million). As per the revised understanding between the Parties, the Buyer is desirous to purchase and the Developer has agreed to sell the Property along with the partially constructed structure on it on ‘where is as is’ basis for a sale consideration of PKR 10,000,000 (Rupees ten million) ( “Purchase Price” ) . 
 For the Purchase Price provided in Clause 2 above, t he Sellers shall sell its rights , title and interest in the Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions stated herein . 
 The Developer acknowledges that the Buyer has paid and the Developer has received the total Purchase Price against the Unit as fully describe in Annexure A appended to this First Addendum . 
 The Buyer confirms and undertakes that the Buyer shall be solely responsible for completion of remaining construction works of the Unit including installation of utilities and other amenities, to furnish the unit and completion of all related works, at her own cost and risk, and she shall not raise any claim whatsoever nature against the Developer in this regard. 
 The Buyer acknowledges and confirms that the only obligation of the Developer under the Agreement to Sell amended via this First Amendment is to transfer all rights, title and interest of the Developer in the Property/Unit in the favour of the Buyer. 
 The Buyer hereby discharge s and releases the Developer , its employees, agents, sub-contractors, successors and assigns from any and all obligations, liabilities, responsibility , whether known or unknown, arising out of the Agreement to Sell . 
 The Buyer further acknowledges and undertakes that the Buyer has no right to raise any claim, interest or demand against the Developer in connection with the Unit and under the Agreement to Sell including inter alia the construction, materials used and finishing works of the Unit . 
 This First A ddendum shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement to Sell . 
 Any conflicting terms in the Agreement to Sell with this First Amendment shall be deemed null and void including inter alia the Developer’s warranties and the obligations with respect to the construction and finishing works of the Unit . 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement to Sell shall apply mutatis mutandis , and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of Agreement to Sell and this First Addendum, the provisions of this First Addendum shall prevail. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement to Sell shall bear the same meaning in this First A ddendum , unless otherwise specified. 
 The First A ddendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same addendum . 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Addendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses .
